+"""Generate fresh CPU ns-3/analytical outputs, without importing the DAG runtime."""
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.dag_phase5.collective import digest, run, save_json
+
+
+def generate(inputs, binaries, output):
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    frozen = json.loads((inputs / "frozen-inputs.json").read_text())
+    build_root = Path((binaries / "build-root.txt").read_text().strip())
+    libraries = build_root / "astra-sim-alibabacloud/extern/network_backend/ns3-interface/simulation/build/lib"
+    if not libraries.is_dir():
+        raise ValueError("ns-3 build libraries are missing; rebuild with build_wsl.sh")
+    os.environ["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = str(libraries) + os.pathsep + os.environ.get("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "")
+    expected = {}
+    for line in (binaries / "binaries.sha256").read_text().splitlines():
+        value, name = line.split()
+        if digest(binaries / name) != value:
+            raise ValueError(f"binary checksum mismatch: {name}")
+        expected[name] = value
+    records = []
+    for case, payload in frozen["payload_bytes"].items():
+        for backend in ("analytical", "ns3"):
+            print(f"Generating {backend}: {case}, {payload} bytes", flush=True)
+            destination = output / case / backend
+            run(inputs, binaries, backend, case, destination)
+            records.append(dict(case=case, backend=backend, payload_bytes=payload,
+                                collective_sha256=digest(destination / "collective.json")))
+    save_json(output / "backend-manifest.json", dict(
+        reference_nature="simulated", fresh_execution=True, hardware_accuracy_claim=False,
+        binaries_sha256=expected, frozen_inputs_sha256=digest(inputs / "frozen-inputs.json"),
+        build_evidence_sha256={name: digest(binaries / name) for name in
+                              ("build-inputs.log", "analytical-build.log", "ns3-build.log", "build-status.txt", "binaries.sha256")},
+        library_directory=str(libraries),
+        library_sha256={p.name: digest(p) for p in sorted(libraries.glob("libns3*.so"))},
+        records=records,
+        artifact_sha256={p.relative_to(output).as_posix(): digest(p)
+                         for p in sorted(output.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--inputs", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--binaries", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    generate(args.inputs.resolve(), args.binaries.resolve(), args.output.resolve())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+from dataclasses import replace
+
+import pytest
+
+from schemas.dag.v1.contracts import ResourceDemand
+from vidur.dag.executor import DagExecutor
+from vidur.dag.resources import CapacityResourceManager, ResourceCapacity, resource_timeline
+from vidur.dag.runner import DagRunner
+from vidur.dag.trace import write_results
+
+
+def manager():
+    return CapacityResourceManager({
+        "gpu:0": ResourceCapacity(1, "permits"),
+        "nic:0": ResourceCapacity(1, "permits"),
+        "kv:0": ResourceCapacity(100, "bytes"),
+    })
+
+
+def with_demands(graph, overrides):
+    return replace(graph, tasks=tuple(
+        replace(task, demands=tuple(overrides.get(task.task_id, task.demands)))
+        for task in graph.tasks
+    ))
+
+
+def run(graph, capacities):
+    units = {resource: value.unit for resource, value in capacities._capacities.items()}
+    runner = DagRunner(DagExecutor(capacities, resource_units=units))
+    runner.submit(graph)
+    assert runner.run() >= 0
+    return runner
+
+
+def test_resource_contention_acceptance_cases(graph_factory):
+    base = graph_factory({"T1": 10e-6, "T2": 4e-6, "T3": 8e-6},
+                         (("T1", "T3"), ("T2", "T3")))
+    shared = run(with_demands(base, {
+        tid: (ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 1, "permits"),) for tid in ("T1", "T2", "T3")
+    }), manager())
+    assert shared.now == pytest.approx(22e-6)
+
+    independent = run(with_demands(base, {
+        "T1": (ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 1, "permits"),),
+        "T2": (ResourceDemand("nic:0", 1, "permits"),),
+        "T3": (ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 1, "permits"),),
+    }), manager())
+    assert independent.now == pytest.approx(18e-6)
+
+    comm_uses_compute = run(with_demands(base, {
+        "T1": (ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 1, "permits"),),
+        "T2": (ResourceDemand("nic:0", 1, "permits"), ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 1, "permits")),
+        "T3": (ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 1, "permits"),),
+    }), manager())
+    assert comm_uses_compute.now == pytest.approx(22e-6)
+
+
+def test_multi_resource_failure_is_atomic_and_waiters_wake_in_order():
+    capacities = manager()
+    first = capacities.try_acquire(("g", "first"), (ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 1, "permits"),))
+    assert first is not None
+    assert capacities.try_acquire(("g", "wait"), (
+        ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 1, "permits"), ResourceDemand("nic:0", 1, "permits"),
+    )) is None
+    assert capacities.usage_snapshot()["nic:0"]["used"] == 0
+    assert capacities.release(first, 2) == (("g", "wait"),)
+    acquired = capacities.try_acquire(("g", "wait"), (
+        ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 1, "permits"), ResourceDemand("nic:0", 1, "permits"),
+    ))
+    assert acquired is not None
+    assert capacities.usage_snapshot()["gpu:0"]["used"] == 1
+    assert capacities.usage_snapshot()["nic:0"]["used"] == 1
+
+
+def test_kv_reserve_commit_pin_release_lifecycle_and_capacity_backpressure():
+    capacities = manager()
+    reserved = capacities.reserve(("g", "producer"), "kv:0", 80)
+    assert reserved is not None
+    assert capacities.reserve(("g", "consumer"), "kv:0", 30) is None
+    capacities.commit(reserved, "request-1")
+    pin = capacities.pin(("g", "transfer"), "request-1")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="pinned"):
+        capacities.release(reserved, 1)
+    capacities.unpin(pin, 2)
+    assert capacities.release(reserved, 3) == (("g", "consumer"),)
+    assert capacities.reserve(("g", "consumer"), "kv:0", 30) is not None
+

+def test_kv_lifecycle_rejects_duplicate_commit_unpin_and_release():
+    capacities = manager()
+    reservation = capacities.reserve(("g", "producer"), "kv:0", 40)
+    assert reservation is not None
+    capacities.commit(reservation, "request-1")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="already been committed"):
+        capacities.commit(reservation, "request-2")
+    pin = capacities.pin(("g", "transfer"), "request-1")
+    capacities.unpin(pin, 1)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="duplicate or unknown pin"):
+        capacities.unpin(pin, 2)
+    capacities.release(reservation, 3)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="duplicate or unknown reservation"):
+        capacities.release(reservation, 4)
+    assert capacities.usage_snapshot()["kv:0"]["used"] == 0

+
+def test_invalid_or_oversized_requests_do_not_change_capacity():
+    capacities = manager()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="exceeds capacity"):
+        capacities.try_acquire(("g", "too-large"), (ResourceDemand("gpu:0", 2, "permits"),))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="exceeds capacity"):
+        capacities.reserve(("g", "too-large"), "kv:0", 101)
+    assert all(value["used"] == 0 for value in capacities.usage_snapshot().values())

+def test_resource_timeline_uses_executor_start_and_finish_times(graph_factory):

+def test_capacity_trace_writes_resource_timeline_and_final_usage(graph_factory, tmp_path):

+    assert summary["resource_capacity"]["gpu:0"]["used"] == 0

+    assert lines[0].startswith("resource_id,unit")
+    assert "gpu:0,permits,1,synthetic,A,0" in lines[1]

+def test_failed_task_records_actual_release_interval_and_failed_report(graph_factory, tmp_path):
+    from schemas.dag.v1.contracts import TaskState

+    # Stale completion must neither release again nor extend the occupancy.

+def test_graph_failure_cancels_only_its_waiters_and_keeps_other_graphs(graph_factory):
+    capacities = manager()

+"""Original Stage boundary, host ordering, single-clock and failure regressions."""
+import heapq
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from vidur.dag.host import CoarseDagAdapter, DagHostEvent
+from vidur.events.batch_stage_end_event import BatchStageEndEvent
+
+
+def submit(adapter, *, duration=2.0, replica=1, stage=0, batch_id=1, now=0):
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(id=batch_id, requests=[SimpleNamespace(id=1)])
+    batch_stage = SimpleNamespace(id=batch_id, execution_time=duration)
+    return adapter.submit_stage(now, replica, stage, True, batch, batch_stage)
+
+
+def drain(events):
+    queue = [(e._priority_number, e) for e in events]
+    heapq.heapify(queue)
+    ends = []
+    while queue:
+        _, event = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        if isinstance(event, BatchStageEndEvent):
+            ends.append(event)
+        else:
+            for successor in event.handle_event(None, None):
+                heapq.heappush(queue, (successor._priority_number, successor))
+    return ends
+
+
+def test_terminal_alone_emits_stage_end_and_cost_is_charged_once():
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0)])
+    events = submit(adapter)
+    assert len(events) == 1 and isinstance(events[0], DagHostEvent)
+    terminal, = events[0].handle_event(None, None)
+    assert isinstance(terminal, DagHostEvent) and terminal.time == 2
+    end, = terminal.handle_event(None, None)
+    assert isinstance(end, BatchStageEndEvent) and end.time == 2
+    graph, = adapter.executor.graphs.values()
+    assert graph.callback_count == 1
+    assert graph.tasks["coarse"].spec.cost.duration_s == 2
+    assert graph.tasks["terminal"].spec.cost.duration_s == 0
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        terminal.handle_event(None, None)
+    assert graph.callback_count == 1
+
+
+def test_stage_end_moves_when_host_completion_is_delayed():
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0)])
+    from schemas.dag.v1.contracts import ResourceDemand
+    manager = adapter.executor._resources
+    held = manager.try_acquire(("external", "holder"), (ResourceDemand("stage:1:0", 1, "permits"),))
+    assert submit(adapter) == []
+    manager.release(held, 5)
+    end, = drain(adapter._wrap(adapter.executor.dispatch(5)))
+    assert end.time == 7
+    graph, = adapter.executor.graphs.values()
+    assert graph.finished_at == 7 and graph.callback_count == 1
+
+
+def test_internal_events_keep_reserved_legacy_order_at_equal_time():
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0), (2, 0)])
+    first = submit(adapter, replica=1)
+    second = submit(adapter, replica=2, batch_id=2)
+    ends = drain(first + second)
+    assert [end._replica_id for end in ends] == [1, 2]
+    assert [end.time for end in ends] == [2, 2]
+
+
+def test_arrival_between_completion_and_terminal_cannot_overtake_stage_end():
+    from vidur.events.replica_stage_schedule_event import ReplicaStageScheduleEvent
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0)])
+    completion, = submit(adapter)
+    other = ReplicaStageScheduleEvent(2, 1, 0)
+    terminal, = completion.handle_event(None, None)
+    assert terminal._priority_number < other._priority_number
+    end, = terminal.handle_event(None, None)
+    assert end._priority_number < other._priority_number
+
+
+def test_replica_stage_resources_are_independent():
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0), (1, 1), (2, 0)])
+    events = submit(adapter) + submit(adapter, stage=1, batch_id=2) + submit(adapter, replica=2, batch_id=3)
+    ends = drain(events)
+    assert len(ends) == 3 and all(end.time == 2 for end in ends)
+    assert all(value["used"] == 0 for value in adapter.executor._resources.usage_snapshot().values())
+
+
+def test_resource_wait_really_delays_stage_end():
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0)])
+    first = submit(adapter)
+    blocked = submit(adapter, batch_id=2)
+    assert blocked == []
+    ends = drain(first)
+    assert [end.time for end in ends] == [2, 4]

+
+def test_zero_duration_coarse_converges_and_iteration_ids_are_unique():
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0)])
+    assert drain(submit(adapter, duration=0))[0].time == 0
+    assert drain(submit(adapter, duration=0))[0].time == 0
+    assert len(adapter.executor.graphs) == 2
+    assert all(graph.callback_count == 1 for graph in adapter.executor.graphs.values())

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("duration", [-1, float("nan"), float("inf")])
+def test_invalid_predictor_cost_is_rejected(duration):
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0)])

+def submit(host, *, replica=0, now=0, tokens=8, execution_time=None, phase="prefill"):
+    request = Request(now, tokens, 4)

+                            num_prefill_tokens=tokens if phase == "prefill" else 0,
+                            num_decode_tokens=tokens if phase == "decode" else 0)
+    stage = BatchStage(batch.id, replica, 0, 0, 0, [request], [tokens])
+    record = {}
+    events = host.submit_stage(now, replica, 0, True, batch, stage, on_stage_start=stage.on_schedule,
+                               execution_time=execution_time or snapshot(), record=record)
+    return events, stage, request, record

+from dataclasses import replace
+import heapq
+from itertools import count
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from schemas.dag.v1.contracts import TaskState
+from vidur.dag.executor import DagExecutor
+from vidur.dag.serialization import load_graph
+
+FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "fixtures/dag/v1"
+
+
+def drain(executor, initial_events):
+    queue, sequence = [], count()
+    for event in initial_events:
+        heapq.heappush(queue, (event.time_s, next(sequence), event))
+    while queue:
+        now, _, event = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        assert event.kind == "task_complete"
+        for intent in executor.on_task_complete(*event.owner, now):
+            heapq.heappush(queue, (intent.time_s, next(sequence), intent))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name,total", [("serial", 10e-6), ("fork_join", 7e-6)])
+def test_execute_actual_graph(name, total):
+    import json
+    graph = load_graph(FIXTURES / f"{name}.graph.json")
+    executor = DagExecutor(dependency_only=True)
+    callbacks = []
+    def callback(gid, now):
+        callbacks.append((gid, now))
+        return ()
+    handle = executor.submit(graph, 0, callback)
+    drain(executor, handle.initial_events)
+    result = executor.graphs[graph.graph_id]
+    expected = json.loads((FIXTURES / f"{name}.expected.json").read_text())["scenarios"][0]
+    for tid, interval in expected["schedule_s"].items():
+        task = result.tasks[tid]
+        assert (task.start_at, task.end_at) == pytest.approx(interval, abs=1e-15)
+        assert task.state == TaskState.COMPLETED
+        assert task.completion_count == 1
+    assert result.finished_at == pytest.approx(total, abs=1e-15)
+    assert result.callback_count == len(callbacks) == 1
+
+
+def test_join_waits_for_all_predecessors_and_rejects_duplicate_completion():
+    executor = DagExecutor(dependency_only=True)
+    graph = load_graph(FIXTURES / "fork_join.graph.json")
+    events = executor.submit(graph, 0, lambda *_: ()).initial_events
+    assert [e.owner[1] for e in events] == ["T1", "T2"]
+    assert executor.dispatch(0) == ()
+    assert executor.on_task_complete("fork_join", "T1", events[0].time_s) == ()
+    assert executor.graphs["fork_join"].tasks["T3"].remaining_predecessors == 1
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="RUNNING"):
+        executor.on_task_complete("fork_join", "T1", events[0].time_s)
+    assert executor.graphs["fork_join"].tasks["T3"].remaining_predecessors == 1
+
+
+def test_invalid_completion_does_not_advance_clock():
+    executor = DagExecutor(dependency_only=True)
+    event = executor.submit(load_graph(FIXTURES / "serial.graph.json"), 0, lambda *_: ()).initial_events[0]
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="time mismatch"):
+        executor.on_task_complete(*event.owner, 1)
+    assert executor.now == 0
+    executor.on_task_complete(*event.owner, event.time_s)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="backwards"):
+        executor.dispatch(0)
+

+def test_submit_failure_atomic_and_resource_mode_explicit():
+    executor = DagExecutor()
+    graph = load_graph(FIXTURES / "serial.graph.json")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="require"):
+        executor.submit(graph, 10, lambda *_: ())
+    assert executor.graphs == {} and executor.now == 0
+    invalid = replace(graph, edges=((*graph.edges, ("terminal", "T1"))))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="cycle"):
+        executor.submit(invalid, 10, lambda *_: ())
+    assert executor.graphs == {} and executor.now == 0
+
+
+def test_inspection_does_not_expose_mutable_runtime():
+    executor = DagExecutor(dependency_only=True)
+    executor.submit(load_graph(FIXTURES / "serial.graph.json"), 0, lambda *_: ())
+    snapshot = executor.graphs
+    snapshot["serial"].tasks["T1"].state = TaskState.FAILED
+    assert executor.graphs["serial"].tasks["T1"].state == TaskState.RUNNING

+    def can_allocate(self, blocks):

+    def allocate(self, rid, blocks):

+    def free(self, rid):

+    def release_memory(self, request):

+import pytest
+from vidur.dag.kv_layout import KVLayout
+from vidur.dag.pd_lifecycle import KVTransactions, Migration
+from vidur.dag.resources import CapacityResourceManager, ResourceCapacity
+
+
+def transactions(capacity=64):
+    layout = KVLayout(1, 1, 1, 2, 1, "float16", 1)
+    manager = CapacityResourceManager({"kv:"+gpu: ResourceCapacity(capacity, "bytes")
+                                      for gpu in layout.shards(0)})
+    return KVTransactions(manager, layout)
+
+
+def test_reserve_commit_pin_release_once():
+    tx = transactions()
+    handles = tx.reserve("r", 0, 32, "source", 0)
+    tx.commit("r", handles, "source", 0)
+    m = Migration("r", 0, 1, 32, 16, source_handles=handles)
+    tx.pin(m, 1)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="pinned"):
+        tx.manager.release(handles[0], 1)
+    assert all(v["used"] == 32 for v in tx.manager.usage_snapshot().values())
+    tx.unpin(m, 2)
+    tx.release("r", handles, 2)
+    assert handles == [] and not m.pins
+    assert all(v["used"] == 0 for v in tx.manager.usage_snapshot().values())
+
+
+def test_partial_reservation_rolls_back():
+    tx = transactions()
+    last = tx.layout.shards(0)[-1]
+    blocker = tx.manager.reserve(("external", "owner"), "kv:"+last, 64)
+    assert tx.reserve("r", 0, 32, "destination", 1) is None
+    values = list(tx.manager.usage_snapshot().values())
+    assert [v["used"] for v in values] == [0, 64]
+    tx.manager.release(blocker, 2)
+    handles = tx.reserve("r", 0, 32, "destination", 2)
+    tx.release("r", handles, 3)
+    assert all(v["used"] == 0 for v in tx.manager.usage_snapshot().values())
+
+
+def test_commit_does_not_charge_capacity_again():
+    tx = transactions()
+    handles = tx.reserve("r", 0, 32, "destination", 0)
+    before = tx.manager.usage_snapshot()
+    tx.commit("r", handles, "destination", 1)
+    assert before == tx.manager.usage_snapshot()
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="already been committed"):
+        tx.commit("r", handles, "destination", 1)
+    tx.release("r", handles, 2)

+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0)]) if mode == "dag_coarse" else None
+    simulator = host(tmp_path, adapter, limit=1)
+    observed = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(BatchStageEndEvent, "handle_event", lambda self, *_: observed.append(self.time) or [])
+    events = stage(adapter, duration=duration) if adapter else [
+        BatchStageEndEvent(duration, 1, 0, True, SimpleNamespace(), SimpleNamespace())]
+    simulator._add_events(events)
+    simulator.run()
+    assert observed == ([duration] if completed else [])
+    assert simulator._time == (duration if completed else 1)
+    assert simulator._terminate is not completed
+    assert len(simulator._event_queue) == (0 if completed else 1)
+    if adapter:
+        graph, = adapter.executor.graphs.values()
+        assert graph.callback_count == int(completed)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", ["graph", "host"])
+def test_global_abort_cleans_running_and_waiting_graphs_once(tmp_path, source):
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0), (2, 0)])
+    simulator = host(tmp_path, adapter)
+    initial = stage(adapter, 1, 1) + stage(adapter, 2, 2) + stage(adapter, 2, 3)
+    simulator._add_events(initial)
+    first = next(iter(adapter.executor.graphs))
+    manager = adapter.executor._resources
+    releases = []
+    original_release = manager.release
+
+    def release(lease, now):
+        releases.append(lease.lease_id)
+        return original_release(lease, now)
+
+    manager.release = release
+
+    def fail(*_):
+        if source == "host":
+            raise RuntimeError("injected host failure")
+        return adapter._wrap(adapter.executor.fail_task(first, "coarse", 1, "injected graph failure"))
+
+    simulator._add_event(SimpleNamespace(time=1, _time=1, _event_type="failure",
+        _priority_number=(1, -1, None), handle_event=fail))
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected"):
+        simulator.run()
+    adapter.abort(1, "repeat cleanup")
+    assert not simulator._event_queue and adapter.pending_event_count == 0
+    assert len(releases) == len(set(releases)) == 2
+    assert not manager._waiters
+    assert all(value["used"] == 0 for value in manager.usage_snapshot().values())
+    for graph in adapter.executor.graphs.values():
+        assert graph.state == "FAILED" and graph.callback_count == 0

+    assert waiter.resource_wait_s == 1 and waiter.resource_wait_started_at is None
+    # Stale completion events cannot run callbacks or release leases again.
+    assert all(event.handle_event(None, None) == [] for event in initial)

+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected"):

+def test_abort_keeps_completed_results_and_reports_failed_release(tmp_path):
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0), (2, 0)])
+    events = stage(adapter, 1, 1, duration=0)
+    while events:
+        event = events.pop(0)
+        if not isinstance(event, BatchStageEndEvent):
+            events.extend(event.handle_event(None, None))
+    stage(adapter, 2, 2)
+    completed_id, failed_id = adapter.executor.graphs
+    releases = []
+
+    def broken(lease, now):
+        releases.append(lease.lease_id)
+        raise OSError("injected release error")
+
+    adapter.executor._resources.release = broken
+    adapter.abort(1, "global abort")
+    adapter.abort(1, "repeat")
+    assert len(releases) == 1
+    assert adapter.executor.graphs[completed_id].state == "COMPLETED"
+    assert adapter.executor.graphs[completed_id].callback_count == 1
+    graph = adapter.executor.graphs[failed_id]
+    assert graph.state == "FAILED" and graph.callback_count == 0
+    assert graph.tasks["coarse"].lease is not None
+    assert any("not confirmed" in error for error in graph.cleanup_errors)

+"""Real StageEnd and request accounting after a delayed coarse dispatch."""
+import pytest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from schemas.dag.v1.contracts import ResourceDemand
+from vidur.dag.host import CoarseDagAdapter
+from vidur.entities import Request
+from vidur.events.batch_stage_end_event import BatchStageEndEvent
+from vidur.events.replica_stage_schedule_event import ReplicaStageScheduleEvent
+from vidur.scheduler.replica_stage_scheduler.replica_stage_schduler import ReplicaStageScheduler
+
+
+def waiting_stage(submitted_at=0, *, previous_stage=False, duration=2):
+    request = Request(0, 8, 4)
+    request.on_batch_schedule(0)
+    if previous_stage:
+        request.on_batch_stage_schedule(0.5)
+        request.on_batch_stage_end(1, 0.5, 0.4)
+    predictor = SimpleNamespace(get_execution_time=lambda *_: SimpleNamespace(total_time=duration, model_time=1))
+    stage = ReplicaStageScheduler(1, 0, True, predictor)
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(id=1, requests=[request], request_ids=[request.id], num_tokens=[8])
+    stage.add_batch(batch)
+    adapter = CoarseDagAdapter([(1, 0)])
+    manager = adapter.executor._resources
+    held = manager.try_acquire(("external", "holder"), (ResourceDemand("stage:1:0", 1, "permits"),))
+    scheduler = SimpleNamespace(_replica_schedulers={1: SimpleNamespace(_replica_stage_schedulers={0: stage})},
+        get_replica_stage_scheduler=lambda *_: stage, dag_adapter=adapter, stage_execution_records=[])
+    starts, ends = [], []
+    metrics = SimpleNamespace(on_replica_stage_schedule=lambda time, *_: starts.append(time),
+                              on_batch_stage_end=lambda batch_stage, time, *rest: ends.append(time))
+    event = ReplicaStageScheduleEvent(submitted_at, 1, 0)
+    assert event.handle_event(scheduler, metrics) == []
+    return request, event, adapter, manager, held, scheduler, metrics, starts, ends
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("submitted_at,previous_stage", [(0, False), (2, True)])
+def test_real_stage_end_keeps_wait_separate_from_execution(submitted_at, previous_stage):
+    request, event, adapter, manager, held, scheduler, metrics, starts, ends = waiting_stage(
+        submitted_at, previous_stage=previous_stage)
+    record, = scheduler.stage_execution_records
+    assert record["submitted_at_s"] == submitted_at
+    assert record["start_at_s"] is None and record["resource_wait_s"] is None
+    assert not event._batch_stage._scheduled and starts == []
+    assert request.to_dict()["stage_resource_wait_time_s"] == 0
+    manager.release(held, 5)
+    completion, = adapter._wrap(adapter.executor.dispatch(5))
+    assert starts == [5] and event._batch_stage.scheduled_at == 5
+    assert record["start_at_s"] == 5 and record["resource_wait_s"] == 5 - submitted_at
+    terminal, = completion.handle_event(scheduler, metrics)
+    end, = terminal.handle_event(scheduler, metrics)
+    assert isinstance(end, BatchStageEndEvent)
+    successors = end.handle_event(scheduler, metrics)  # Run real StageEnd, not just collect it.
+    assert successors and ends == [7]
+    assert event._batch_stage.completed_at == 7
+    assert not scheduler.get_replica_stage_scheduler(1, 0)._is_busy
+    assert record["completion_count"] == 1 and record["end_at_s"] == 7
+    assert request.execution_time == 2 + (0.5 if previous_stage else 0)
+    assert request.to_dict()["stage_resource_wait_time_s"] == 5 - submitted_at
+    assert request.preempted_time == (4 if previous_stage else 0)
+    assert manager.usage_snapshot()["stage:1:0"]["used"] == 0
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="duplicate"):
+        end.handle_event(scheduler, metrics)
+    assert request.execution_time == 2 + (0.5 if previous_stage else 0)
+
+
+def test_abort_before_dispatch_never_marks_stage_running():
+    request, event, adapter, manager, held, scheduler, metrics, starts, ends = waiting_stage()
+    adapter.abort(1, "cancel while waiting")
+    manager.release(held, 5)
+    assert adapter._wrap(adapter.executor.dispatch(5)) == []
+    assert not adapter._stage_starts and starts == ends == []
+    assert not event._batch_stage._scheduled
+    assert scheduler.stage_execution_records[0]["start_at_s"] is None
+    assert request.to_dict()["stage_resource_wait_time_s"] == 0
+
+
+def test_zero_duration_after_wait_runs_real_stage_end():
+    request, event, adapter, manager, held, scheduler, metrics, starts, ends = waiting_stage(duration=0)
+    manager.release(held, 5)
+    completion, = adapter._wrap(adapter.executor.dispatch(5))
+    terminal, = completion.handle_event(scheduler, metrics)
+    end, = terminal.handle_event(scheduler, metrics)
+    end.handle_event(scheduler, metrics)
+    assert starts == ends == [5] and request.execution_time == 0
+    assert request.to_dict()["stage_resource_wait_time_s"] == 5
+
+
+def test_waiting_stage_snapshot_at_time_limit(tmp_path):
+    from vidur.simulator import Simulator
+    request, event, adapter, manager, held, scheduler, metrics, starts, ends = waiting_stage()
+    simulator = Simulator.__new__(Simulator)
+    simulator._config = SimpleNamespace(metrics_config=SimpleNamespace(write_json_trace=False, enable_chrome_trace=False))
+    simulator._time, simulator._time_limit, simulator._terminate, simulator._failure = 0, 3, False, None
+    simulator._scheduler, simulator._metric_store = scheduler, metrics
+    simulator._cluster, simulator._requests, simulator._event_queue = "controlled waiting stage", [request], []
+    scheduler.is_empty = lambda: False
+    simulator._add_event(SimpleNamespace(time=5, _time=5, _priority_number=(5, 0, None)))
+    simulator.run()
+    assert simulator._time == 3 and simulator._terminate
+    assert not event._batch_stage._scheduled and not starts
+    assert scheduler.stage_execution_records[0]["start_at_s"] is None
+    assert request.execution_time == 0

+    frozen_hash = sha256(freeze.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

+"""PD and MoE share one host clock and resource manager across P/D EP groups."""
+import json
+from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
+
+import pytest
+
+from vidur.dag.moe import load_config
+from vidur.dag.moe_host import DynamicMoeDagAdapter
+from vidur.dag.pd import PDConfig
+from vidur.dag.pd_host import PDCoordinator
+from vidur.entities import BatchStage
+from test_coarse_host import drain
+from test_dynamic_moe import config
+from test_expanded_stage import snapshot
+from test_pd_host import ReplicaScheduler, drain_transfer, prefill
+
+
+def joint_configs():
+    configs = []
+    groups = {}
+    for role, ranks in (("prefill", (0, 1)), ("decode", (2, 3))):
+        data = config(["balanced", "hotspot"])
+        data["group"] = role
+        devices = [f"gpu:{rank}:0:0" for rank in ranks]
+        data["experts"] = {f"e{i}": devices[i // 2] for i in range(4)}
+        configs.append(data)
+        groups[role] = dict(members=devices, bandwidth_bytes_per_s=dict(prefill=1e6, decode=1e6),
+                            evidence="synthetic joint unit test")
+    return configs, dict(ep_groups=groups, endpoints={f"gpu:{i}:0:0": "shared" for i in range(4)})
+
+
+def make_host(configs=None, *, ready_queue_policy="submission"):
+    data, resources = joint_configs()
+    resources["ready_queue_policy"] = ready_queue_policy
+    return DynamicMoeDagAdapter([(i, 0) for i in range(4)], 1, "vidur", "dense", resources,
+                                tuple(configs or data))
+
+
+def test_load_multiple_groups_and_reject_missing_or_duplicate_members(tmp_path):
+    configs, _ = joint_configs()
+    path = tmp_path / "groups.json"
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(dict(schema_version="1.0", groups=configs)))
+    assert len(load_config(path)) == 2
+    make_host(load_config(path))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="uniquely named"):
+        make_host([configs[0], configs[0]])
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="cover all"):
+        make_host([configs[0]])
+
+
+def test_joint_ep_groups_cannot_cross_prefill_decode_boundary():
+    host = make_host()
+    host.validate_pd_groups({str(i): "P" if i < 2 else "D" for i in range(4)})
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="stay within"):
+        host.validate_pd_groups({str(i): "P" if i % 2 == 0 else "D" for i in range(4)})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("policy", ["submission", "fcfs"])
+def test_transfer_then_dynamic_decode_and_final_kv_cleanup(tmp_path, policy):
+    from vidur.entities.replica import ReplicaType
+    replicas = {rid: ReplicaScheduler(rid, 1, 1) for rid in range(4)}
+    for rid, rs in replicas.items():
+        rs.replica.replica_type = ReplicaType.PREFILL if rid < 2 else ReplicaType.DECODE
+    scheduler = NS(_replica_schedulers=replicas, get_replica_scheduler=replicas.__getitem__)
+    host = make_host(ready_queue_policy=policy)
+    pd = PDCoordinator(scheduler, host, PDConfig("float16", 64, 4, 0, True, "synthetic"), 8)
+    assert host.executor.ready_queue_policy == policy
+    scheduler.pd_coordinator = pd
+    request = prefill(pd, replicas)
+    # The helper chooses destination 1; put the request on an actual D rank.
+    migration = pd.migrations[str(request.id)]
+    migration.destination = request.decode_replica_id = 2
+    assert pd.manager is host.executor._resources
+    drain_transfer(pd.retry(1))
+    ready = migration.kv_ready_at_s
+    assert ready == 3 and not migration.pins and not migration.source_handles
+    pd.now = ready
+    batch = pd.next_batch(replicas[2])
+    stage = BatchStage(batch.id, 2, 0, 0, 0, batch.requests, batch.num_tokens)
+    record = {}
+    def start(now):
+        pd.on_stage_start(batch, 2, now)
+        stage.on_schedule(now)
+    end, = drain(host.submit_stage(ready, 2, 0, True, batch, stage,
+        on_stage_start=start, execution_time=snapshot(), record=record))
+    assert migration.first_decode_start_s >= ready
+    assert host.rounds[0]["group"] == "decode"
+    graph = host.executor.graph_snapshot(record["graph_id"])
+    assert all(set(task.spec.placement.device_ids).issubset({"gpu:2:0:0", "gpu:3:0:0"})
+               for task in graph.tasks.values() if task.spec.metadata.get("op", "").startswith("expert."))
+    stage.on_stage_end(end.time)
+    request._completed = True
+    pd.now = end.time
+    pd.on_batch_end(replicas[2], batch)
+    pd.assert_completed()
+    host.assert_completed()
+    assert all(value["used"] == 0 for value in pd.manager.usage_snapshot().values())
+    host.write_moe_results(tmp_path)
+    exported = json.loads((tmp_path / "moe-routing.json").read_text())
+    assert exported["rounds"][0]["expert_devices"]["e0"] == "gpu:2:0:0"

+def test_group_selection_keeps_prefill_and_decode_routes_separate():
+    from test_dynamic_moe import submit

+    from test_dynamic_moe import submit

+    def no_per_round_copy(*_):
+        raise AssertionError("export should reuse one detached graph dictionary")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(host.executor, "graph_snapshot", no_per_round_copy)
+    host.write_moe_results(tmp_path)
+    assert len(json.loads((tmp_path / "moe-routing.json").read_text())["rounds"]) == 3

+def test_joint_host_failure_releases_decode_kv_and_all_task_leases(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    from vidur.entities.replica import ReplicaType
+    from test_phase4_boundaries import host as simulator_host
+    replicas = {rid: ReplicaScheduler(rid, 1, 1) for rid in range(4)}
+    for rid, rs in replicas.items():
+        rs.replica.replica_type = ReplicaType.PREFILL if rid < 2 else ReplicaType.DECODE
+    scheduler = NS(_replica_schedulers=replicas, get_replica_scheduler=replicas.__getitem__, is_empty=lambda: True)
+    host = make_host()
+    pd = PDCoordinator(scheduler, host, PDConfig("float16", 64, 4, 0, True, "synthetic"), 8)
+    scheduler.pd_coordinator, scheduler.dag_adapter = pd, host
+    request = prefill(pd, replicas)
+    migration = pd.migrations[str(request.id)]
+    migration.destination = request.decode_replica_id = 2
+    drain_transfer(pd.retry(1))
+    pd.now = 3
+    batch = pd.next_batch(replicas[2])
+    stage = BatchStage(batch.id, 2, 0, 0, 0, batch.requests, batch.num_tokens)
+    events = host.submit_stage(3, 2, 0, True, batch, stage, on_stage_start=stage.on_schedule,
+                               execution_time=snapshot())
+    def failed_expansion(*_):
+        raise RuntimeError("injected joint routing failure")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(host, "_expand", failed_expansion)
+    simulator = simulator_host(tmp_path, host)
+    simulator._time = 3
+    simulator._scheduler = scheduler
+    simulator._requests = [request]
+    simulator._add_events(events)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="joint routing failure"):
+        simulator.run()
+    assert pd.failure and not simulator._event_queue
+    assert not migration.destination_handles and not migration.source_handles and not migration.pins
+    assert all(v["used"] == 0 for v in pd.manager.usage_snapshot().values())

+"""Check evidence admission and raw-output replay without requiring Linux/GPU."""
+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from scripts.dag_phase4.main import write_json

+from scripts.dag_phase8.accuracy import digest
+
+
+def model_evidence(folder):
+    inputs = folder / "inputs"
+    inputs.mkdir()
+    (inputs / "request.txt").write_text("frozen request")
+    write_json(inputs / "frozen-inputs.json", dict(payload_bytes=dict(decode=65536)))
+    write_json(folder / "experiment-freeze.json", dict(input_sha256={
+        "inputs/request.txt": digest(inputs / "request.txt"),
+        "inputs/frozen-inputs.json": digest(inputs / "frozen-inputs.json")}))
+    backend = folder / "backend-reference"
+    entries = []
+    for kind in ("analytical", "ns3"):
+        case = backend / "decode" / kind
+        case.mkdir(parents=True)
+        (case / "raw.csv").write_text("layer_name,a,b,c,d,fwd exposed comm,g,h,fwd total comm\nlayer0,0,0,0,0,85.745,0,0,85.745\n")
+        write_json(case / "collective.json", dict(csv="raw.csv", unit="us", values=[85.745]))
+        entries.append(dict(case="decode", backend=kind, payload_bytes=65536,
+                            collective_sha256=digest(case / "collective.json")))
+    write_json(backend / "backend-manifest.json", dict(fresh_execution=True,
+        frozen_inputs_sha256=digest(inputs / "frozen-inputs.json"), records=entries,
+        artifact_sha256={p.relative_to(backend).as_posix(): digest(p) for p in backend.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}))
+    return backend
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["request", "csv", "payload", "unit", "missing"])
+def test_changed_or_incomplete_model_evidence_is_rejected(tmp_path, mutation):
+    backend = model_evidence(tmp_path)
+    assert validate_backend(tmp_path, backend)["fresh_execution"]
+    if mutation == "request":
+        (tmp_path / "inputs/request.txt").write_text("changed request")
+    elif mutation == "csv":
+        (backend / "decode/ns3/raw.csv").write_text("layer_name,fwd total comm\nlayer0,1\n")
+    else:
+        path = backend / "backend-manifest.json"
+        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
+        if mutation == "payload":
+            manifest["records"][0]["payload_bytes"] = 1
+        elif mutation == "missing":
+            manifest["records"].pop()
+        else:
+            record = backend / "decode/ns3/collective.json"
+            write_json(record, dict(csv="raw.csv", unit="s", values=[85.745]))
+            manifest["artifact_sha256"]["decode/ns3/collective.json"] = digest(record)
+            manifest["records"][1]["collective_sha256"] = digest(record)
+        write_json(path, manifest)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        validate_backend(tmp_path, backend)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["ns3", "analytical"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rounded_tokens", [8, 8.0])
+def test_replay_preserves_raw_bytes_and_uses_original_predictor_key(tmp_path, monkeypatch, kind, rounded_tokens):
+    from vidur.execution_time_predictor.communication_time_predictor import TPTimePredictor
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+    import scripts.dag_phase8.simulated_reference as experiment
+    monkeypatch.setattr(experiment, "ROOT", tmp_path)
+    backend = model_evidence(tmp_path)
+    # Seed the exact same paths consumed by the actual original predictor.
+    inputs = tmp_path / "inputs"
+    (inputs / experiment.TOPOLOGY).write_text("logical topology")
+    (inputs / "SimAI.conf").write_text("logical configuration")
+    cache = tmp_path / "cli-cache"
+    seed_cache(tmp_path, backend, cache, kind)
+    predictor = TPTimePredictor(SimpleNamespace(num_layers=32, embedding_dim=4096),
+        SimpleNamespace(num_pipeline_stages=1, tensor_parallel_size=8, world_size=8),
+        SimpleNamespace(simai_dir=str(cache), simai_simulation_topo=str(inputs / experiment.TOPOLOGY),
+                        simai_simulation_config=str(inputs / "SimAI.conf"),
+                        simai_analytical_nvlink_gbps=300.0, simai_analytical_nic_gbps=25.0,
+                        simai_analytical_nics_per_server=8,
+                        nccl_cpu_launch_overhead_ms=0, nccl_cpu_skew_overhead_per_device_ms=0))
+    method = predictor.get_execution_time if kind == "ns3" else predictor.get_execution_time_by_simai_analytical
+    assert method(SimpleNamespace(_total_num_tokens_rounded=rounded_tokens)) == pytest.approx(.085745)
+    replayed = list(cache.glob("*EndToEnd_*.csv"))
+    assert len(replayed) == 2
+    assert all(p.read_bytes() == (backend / f"decode/{kind}/raw.csv").read_bytes() for p in replayed)
+
+
+def test_experiment_holds_out_prefill_payloads_and_declares_shared_decode():
+    from scripts.dag_phase8.simulated_reference import EXPERIMENT
+    spec = json.loads(EXPERIMENT.read_text())
+    calibration = [s for s in spec["samples"] if s["split"] == "calibration"]
+    validation = [s for s in spec["samples"] if s["split"] == "validation"]
+    assert len(calibration) == 1 and len(validation) == 3
+    assert not {s["prefill_tokens"] for s in calibration}.intersection(s["prefill_tokens"] for s in validation)
+    assert any("share the Decode" in limit for limit in spec["limitations"])

+"""Ready-time arbitration: no overtaking, stable ties, no unrelated blocking."""
+from dataclasses import replace
+
+import pytest
+
+from schemas.dag.v1.contracts import GraphAppend, ResourceDemand
+from vidur.dag.executor import DagExecutor
+from vidur.dag.expanded import ExpandedDagAdapter
+from vidur.dag.resources import CapacityResourceManager, ResourceCapacity
+from vidur.dag.runner import DagRunner
+
+
+def runner(policy):
+    manager = CapacityResourceManager({"link:shared": ResourceCapacity(1, "permits")})
+    return DagRunner(DagExecutor(manager, resource_units={"link:shared": "permits"},
+                                 ready_queue_policy=policy))
+
+
+def graph(factory, name, prepare, transfer):
+    fragment = factory({"prepare": prepare, "transfer": transfer},
+                       (("prepare", "transfer"),), graph_id=name)
+    return replace(fragment, tasks=tuple(replace(t, kind="comm", demands=(
+        ResourceDemand("link:shared", 1, "permits"),)) if t.task_id == "transfer" else t
+        for t in fragment.tasks))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("policy,order", [("submission", ["busy", "late", "early"]),
+                                          ("fcfs", ["busy", "early", "late"])])
+def test_resource_waiter_keeps_original_ready_time_across_retries(graph_factory, policy, order):
+    run = runner(policy)
+    # 'late' is submitted first, but 'early' reaches the busy link first.
+    for name, prepare, transfer in (("busy", 0, 5), ("late", 3, 1), ("early", 2, 1)):
+        run.submit(graph(graph_factory, name, prepare, transfer))
+    assert run.run() == 7
+    observed = sorted(order, key=lambda name: run.executor.graphs[name].tasks["transfer"].start_at)
+    assert observed == order
+    early = run.executor.graphs["early"].tasks["transfer"]
+    assert early.ready_at == 2
+    assert early.resource_wait_s == (3 if policy == "fcfs" else 4)
+    assert all(t.completion_count == 1 for g in run.executor.graphs.values() for t in g.tasks.values())
+    assert all(v["used"] == 0 for v in run.executor._resources.usage_snapshot().values())
+
+
+def test_fcfs_equal_ready_times_use_submission_order(graph_factory):
+    run = runner("fcfs")
+    for name, prepare in (("busy", 0), ("first", 2), ("second", 2)):
+        run.submit(graph(graph_factory, name, prepare, 5 if name == "busy" else 1))
+    run.run()
+    assert run.executor.graphs["first"].tasks["transfer"].start_at == 5
+    assert run.executor.graphs["second"].tasks["transfer"].start_at == 6
+
+
+def test_fcfs_does_not_block_unrelated_resources_or_preempt(graph_factory):
+    run = runner("fcfs")
+    run.submit(graph(graph_factory, "busy", 0, 5))

+def test_terminal_callback_failure_is_once(graph_factory, mode):

+        if mode == "past":
+            return (EventIntent(now-1, "dispatch", (gid, "terminal")),)
+        return executor.dispatch(now)

+import random
+
+import pytest
+
+from schemas.dag.v1.contracts import EventIntent, TaskState
+from vidur.dag.executor import DagExecutor
+from vidur.dag.runner import DagRunner, SimulationFailure
+
+
+def test_terminal_only_and_nonzero_submission(graph_factory):
+    runner = DagRunner()
+    callbacks = []
+    def callback(gid, now):
+        callbacks.append((gid, now))
+        return ()
+    runner.submit(graph_factory({}), 4, callback)
+    assert runner.run() == 4
+    graph = runner.executor.graphs["synthetic"]
+    assert graph.finished_at - graph.submitted_at == 0
+    assert callbacks == [("synthetic", 4)]
+
+
+def test_long_zero_duration_chain_is_iterative(graph_factory):
+    size = 1500
+    graph = graph_factory({str(i): 0 for i in range(size)},
+                          tuple((str(i), str(i+1)) for i in range(size-1)))
+    runner = DagRunner()
+    runner.submit(graph)
+    assert runner.run() == 0
+    assert len(runner.events) == size + 1
+    assert all(t.completion_count == 1 for t in runner.executor.graphs[graph.graph_id].tasks.values())
+
+
+def test_stable_same_time_events_and_multiple_graphs(graph_factory):
+    traces = []
+    for _ in range(3):
+        runner = DagRunner()
+        for gid in ("first", "second"):
+            runner.submit(graph_factory({"A": 1, "B": 1, "C": 0},
+                                       (("A", "C"), ("B", "C")), gid))
+        runner.run()
+        traces.append(runner.events)
+        assert len(runner.executor.graphs) == 2
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="duplicate"):
+            runner.submit(graph_factory({}, graph_id="first"))
+    assert traces[0] == traces[1] == traces[2]
+    assert [(e["graph_id"], e["task_id"]) for e in traces[0][:4]] == [
+        ("first", "A"), ("first", "B"), ("second", "A"), ("second", "B")]
+
+
+def test_random_dags_match_independent_critical_path(graph_factory):
+    rng = random.Random(20261102)
+    for size in (1, 5, 20, 50):
+        for case in range(5):
+            durations = {str(i): rng.randrange(0, 8) * 1e-6 for i in range(size)}
+            edges = tuple((str(i), str(j)) for i in range(size) for j in range(i+1, size)
+                          if rng.random() < 0.12)
+            starts, ends = {}, {}
+            for tid in durations:
+                starts[tid] = max((ends[a] for a, b in edges if b == tid), default=0)
+                ends[tid] = starts[tid] + durations[tid]
+            runner = DagRunner()
+            runner.submit(graph_factory(durations, edges))
+            runner.run()
+            graph = runner.executor.graphs["synthetic"]
+            for tid in durations:
+                assert graph.tasks[tid].start_at == pytest.approx(starts[tid], abs=1e-15)
+                assert graph.tasks[tid].end_at == pytest.approx(ends[tid], abs=1e-15)
+            assert graph.finished_at == pytest.approx(max(ends.values()), abs=1e-15)
+
+
+def test_runner_rejects_past_events_and_future_submit_skipping_pending_work(graph_factory):
+    runner = DagRunner()
+    runner.submit(graph_factory({"A": 1}), 3)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="earlier"):
+        runner.submit(graph_factory({}, graph_id="later"), 5)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="past"):
+        runner.enqueue((EventIntent(2, "dispatch", ("synthetic", "A")),))
+    assert runner.now == 3
+    assert runner.run() == 4
+
+
+def test_callback_event_return_and_invalid_callback(graph_factory):
+    runner = DagRunner()
+    runner.submit(graph_factory({}), terminal_callback=lambda gid, now: (
+        EventIntent(now, "dispatch", (gid, "terminal")),))
+    runner.run()
+    assert [e["kind"] for e in runner.events] == ["task_complete", "dispatch"]
+    invalid = DagRunner()
+    invalid.submit(graph_factory({}), terminal_callback=lambda *_: None)
+    with pytest.raises(SimulationFailure, match="EventIntents"):
+        invalid.run()
+    graph = invalid.executor.graphs["synthetic"]
+    assert graph.callback_count == 1 and graph.state == "FAILED"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("now", [-1, True, "1", float("inf"), float("nan")])
+def test_invalid_host_time(graph_factory, now):
+    executor = DagExecutor()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        executor.submit(graph_factory({}), now, lambda *_: ())
+    assert not executor.graphs
+
+
+def test_completion_time_overflow_fails_graph(graph_factory):
+    runner = DagRunner()
+    runner.submit(graph_factory({"A": 1e308}), 1e308)
+    with pytest.raises(SimulationFailure, match="overflow"):
+        runner.run()
+    graph = runner.executor.graphs["synthetic"]
+    assert graph.tasks["A"].state == TaskState.FAILED
+    assert graph.callback_count == 0
+
+
+def test_positive_duration_cannot_silently_become_zero(graph_factory):
+    runner = DagRunner()
+    runner.submit(graph_factory({"A": 1}), 1e20)
+    with pytest.raises(SimulationFailure, match="precision"):
+        runner.run()
+    assert runner.executor.graphs["synthetic"].tasks["A"].start_at is None
+
+
+def test_enqueue_is_atomic_and_failed_runner_rejects_more_work(graph_factory):
+    runner = DagRunner()
+    runner.submit(graph_factory({"A": 1}), 2)
+    before = runner.pending_event_count
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="past"):
+        runner.enqueue((EventIntent(3, "dispatch", ("synthetic", "A")),
+                        EventIntent(1, "dispatch", ("synthetic", "A"))))
+    assert runner.pending_event_count == before
+    runner.enqueue((EventIntent(2, "graph_failed", ("synthetic", "A")),))
+    with pytest.raises(SimulationFailure):
+        runner.run()
+    with pytest.raises(SimulationFailure):
+        runner.submit(graph_factory({}, graph_id="later"))
+    assert "later" not in runner.executor.graphs

+from dataclasses import replace
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from schemas.dag.v1.io import read_json
+from vidur.dag.serialization import graph_from_dict, graph_to_dict, load_graph, snapshot_graph
+
+FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "fixtures/dag/v1"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["serial", "fork_join", "resource_contention"])
+def test_round_trip(name):
+    source = read_json(FIXTURES / f"{name}.graph.json")
+    for task in source["tasks"]:
+        task.setdefault("metadata", {})
+    assert graph_to_dict(graph_from_dict(source)) == source
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", sorted((FIXTURES / "invalid").glob("*.json")), ids=lambda p: p.stem)
+def test_invalid_graphs_raise_value_error(path):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        load_graph(path)
+
+
+def test_snapshot_copies_mutable_metadata():
+    graph = load_graph(FIXTURES / "serial.graph.json")
+    metadata = {"nested": [1]}
+    graph = replace(graph, tasks=(replace(graph.tasks[0], metadata=metadata), *graph.tasks[1:]))
+    snapshot = snapshot_graph(graph)
+    metadata["nested"].append(2)
+    assert snapshot.tasks[0].metadata == {"nested": [1]}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [True, "3", -1, float("inf"), float("nan")])
+def test_dataclass_values_are_validated(value):
+    graph = load_graph(FIXTURES / "serial.graph.json")
+    graph = replace(graph, tasks=(replace(graph.tasks[0], cost=replace(graph.tasks[0].cost, duration_s=value)), *graph.tasks[1:]))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        snapshot_graph(graph)
+
+
+def test_duplicate_json_keys_rejected(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "duplicate.json"
+    path.write_text('{"graph_id":"one","graph_id":"two"}', encoding="utf-8")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="duplicate JSON key"):
+        read_json(path)
+
+
+def test_metadata_overflow_rejected():
+    data = read_json(FIXTURES / "serial.graph.json")
+    data["tasks"][0]["metadata"] = json.loads('{"value": 1e999}')
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        graph_from_dict(data)

+from abc import ABC
+from dataclasses import dataclass

+
+from vidur.config.utils import get_all_subclasses

+
+@dataclass
+class BaseFixedConfig(ABC):
+

+            if subclass.get_type() == type_:
+                return subclass()
+        raise ValueError(f"[{cls.__name__}] Invalid type: {type_}")

+    def create_from_name(cls, name: str) -> Any:

+        raise ValueError(f"[{cls.__name__}] Invalid type string: {type_str}")

+@dataclass
+class ReplicaConfig:
+    model_name: str = field(
+        default="meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf",
+        metadata={"help": "Model name."},
+    )
+    memory_margin_fraction: float = field(
+        default=0.1,
+        metadata={"help": "Memory margin fraction."},
+    )
+    num_pipeline_stages: int = field(
+        default=1,
+        metadata={"help": "Number of pipeline stages."},
+    )
+    tensor_parallel_size: int = field(
+        default=1,
+        metadata={"help": "Tensor parallel size."},
+    )
+    device: str = field(
+        default="a100",
+        metadata={"help": "Device."},
+    )
+    network_device: str = field(
+        default="a100_pairwise_nvlink",
+        metadata={"help": "Network device."},
+    )
+    
+    # >
+    pd_p2p_comm_bandwidth: int = field(
+        default=800,
+        metadata={"help": "> add: pd_p2p_comm_bandwidth for pd disaggregation. (bps)"},
+    )
+    
+    nvlink_bandwidth: int = field(
+        default=1600,
+        metadata={"help": "> add: nvlink_bandwidth for tp/ep communication et al. (bps)"},
+    )
+    
+    rdma_bandwidth: int = field(
+        default=800,
+        metadata={"help": "> add: rdma_bandwidth for tp/ep communication et al. (bps)"},
+    )
+    
+    pd_p2p_comm_dtype: str = field(
+        default='float16',
+        metadata={
+            "help": "Data type for PD disaggregation P2P communication. "
+                    "Tested: fp8, float16, float32. "
+                    "Other dtypes (float64, bfloat16, int8, int16, int32, int64) are "
+                    "theoretically supported but untested.",
+            "choices": ['fp8', 'float16', 'float32'],
+        },
+    )
+    
+    # pd_node_ratio: float = field(
+    #     default=0.5,
+    #     metadata={"help": "Number of p replicas : number of d replicas."},
+    # )
+    
+    # when pd_node_ratio = 1, all replicas are P-nodes; no D-nodes; that means not pd disaggregation
+    pd_node_ratio: float = field(
+        default=1,
+        metadata={"help": "Fraction of replicas allocated as prefill (P) nodes. "
+                  "pd_node_ratio=1 (default): MIXED mode, all replicas handle both prefill "
+                  "and decode; PD-specific params (prefill_*/decode_*) are ignored. "
+                  "0 < pd_node_ratio < 1: PD separation enabled, prefill and decode run "
+                  "as independent clusters with potentially different TP/PP/EP. "
+                  "E.g., 0.5 means P:D = 1:1. Must be in range (0, 1]."},
+    )
+  
+    # ============================================================
+    # [EP] EP 不支持手动指定。当前实现中 EP 会被自动覆盖为 cluster world_size
+    # (tp×pp×dp)，在 cluster.py 中执行覆盖。若用户传入的值 != world_size，
+    # 将抛出 ValueError。
+    # [EP] EP is not user-configurable. It is auto-set to cluster world_size
+    # (tp*pp*dp) in cluster.py. ValueError raised if user value != world_size.
+    # ============================================================
+    expert_model_parallel_size: int = field(
+        default=1,
+        metadata={"help": "Auto-set to world_size in cluster.py. "
+                  "User value != world_size raises ValueError."},
+    )
+
+    # ============================================================
+    # PD separation specific params (optional, fallback to shared values above if not set)
+    # Reference vLLM: PD separation runs prefill/decode as completely independent clusters
+    # with potentially different TP/PP/EP
+    # PD 分离专用参数 (可选, 未指定时 fallback 到上方共享值)
+    # 参考 vLLM: PD 分离时 prefill/decode 是完全独立的集群
+    # 可以有不同 TP/PP/EP
+    # ============================================================
+    prefill_tensor_parallel_size: Optional[int] = field(
+        default=None,
+        metadata={"help": "Prefill-specific TP size. Falls back to tensor_parallel_size if not set."},
+    )
+    prefill_num_pipeline_stages: Optional[int] = field(
+        default=None,
+        metadata={"help": "Prefill-specific PP size. Falls back to num_pipeline_stages if not set."},
+    )
+    decode_tensor_parallel_size: Optional[int] = field(
+        default=None,
+        metadata={"help": "Decode-specific TP size. Falls back to tensor_parallel_size if not set."},
+    )
+    decode_num_pipeline_stages: Optional[int] = field(
+        default=None,
+        metadata={"help": "Decode-specific PP size. Falls back to num_pipeline_stages if not set."},
+    )
+    # Directly specify prefill replica count, takes priority over pd_node_ratio
+    # More flexible: avoids pd_node_ratio indivisibility issues
+    # 直接指定 prefill replica 数量, 优先于 pd_node_ratio 计算
+    # 更灵活: 避免 pd_node_ratio 不整除的问题
+    num_prefill_replicas: Optional[int] = field(
+        default=None,
+        metadata={"help": "Directly specify number of prefill replicas. "
+                  "Takes priority over pd_node_ratio when set. "
+                  "num_decode_replicas = total_replicas - num_prefill_replicas."},
+    )
+
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        # Base world_size: per-replica GPU count (excluding dp)
+        # 基础 world_size: per-replica 的 GPU 数 (不含 dp)
+        self.world_size = self.num_pipeline_stages * self.tensor_parallel_size
+        
+        # ============================================================
+        # [EP] Reject user-specified EP != world_size, then auto-set
+        # [EP] 拒绝用户传入的 EP != world_size，然后自动设置
+        # ============================================================
+        if self.expert_model_parallel_size != 1 and self.expert_model_parallel_size != self.world_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"EP 不支持手动指定。当前 EP={self.expert_model_parallel_size}，"
+                f"但 world_size={self.world_size}。EP 会在运行时自动设为 world_size。"
+                f"请移除 --replica_config_expert_model_parallel_size 参数或设为 {self.world_size}。"
+            )
+        self.expert_model_parallel_size = self.world_size  # Auto-set, overridden again in cluster.py / 自动设置, cluster.py 会再次覆盖
+        
+        # 打印 ReplicaConfig 配置摘要 | Print ReplicaConfig summary
+        logger.debug(f"[ReplicaConfig] tp={self.tensor_parallel_size}, pp={self.num_pipeline_stages}, "
+              f"per_replica_ws={self.world_size}, ep(temp)={self.expert_model_parallel_size}, "
+              f"pd_ratio={self.pd_node_ratio}")
+        if self.pd_node_ratio < 1:
+            p_tp = self.prefill_tensor_parallel_size or self.tensor_parallel_size
+            p_pp = self.prefill_num_pipeline_stages or self.num_pipeline_stages
+            d_tp = self.decode_tensor_parallel_size or self.tensor_parallel_size
+            d_pp = self.decode_num_pipeline_stages or self.num_pipeline_stages
+            logger.debug(f"[ReplicaConfig] PD separation enabled: "
+                  f"prefill(tp={p_tp}, pp={p_pp}), decode(tp={d_tp}, pp={d_pp})")
+            if self.num_prefill_replicas is not None:
+                logger.debug(f"[ReplicaConfig] User specified num_prefill_replicas={self.num_prefill_replicas}")
+        
+        self.model_config: BaseModelConfig = BaseModelConfig.create_from_name(
+            self.model_name
+        )
+        self.device_config: BaseDeviceSKUConfig = (
+            BaseDeviceSKUConfig.create_from_type_string(self.device)
+        )
+        self.node_config: BaseNodeSKUConfig = BaseNodeSKUConfig.create_from_type_string(
+            self.network_device
+        )
+

+    # num_replicas：指定集群中副本的数量，默认为1个副本
+    # Number of replicas in the cluster, defaults to 1 replica
+    num_replicas: int = field(
+        default=1,

+    )
+    # replica_config：定义每个副本的配置，使用 ReplicaConfig 类作为配置模板

+import json
+from argparse import (
+    ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
+    ArgumentParser,
+    BooleanOptionalAction,
+)
+from collections import defaultdict, deque
+from dataclasses import MISSING, fields, make_dataclass
+from typing import Any, get_args
+
+from vidur.config.base_poly_config import BasePolyConfig
+from vidur.config.utils import (
+    get_all_subclasses,
+    get_inner_type,
+    is_bool,
+    is_composed_of_primitives,
+    is_dict,
+    is_list,
+    is_optional,
+    is_primitive_type,
+    is_subclass,
+    to_snake_case,
+)
+
+
+def topological_sort(dataclass_dependencies: dict) -> list:
+    in_degree = defaultdict(int)
+    for cls, dependencies in dataclass_dependencies.items():
+        for dep in dependencies:
+            in_degree[dep] += 1
+
+    zero_in_degree_classes = deque(
+        [cls for cls in dataclass_dependencies if in_degree[cls] == 0]
+    )
+    sorted_classes = []
+
+    while zero_in_degree_classes:
+        cls = zero_in_degree_classes.popleft()
+        sorted_classes.append(cls)
+        for dep in dataclass_dependencies[cls]:
+            in_degree[dep] -= 1
+            if in_degree[dep] == 0:
+                zero_in_degree_classes.append(dep)
+
+    return sorted_classes
+
+
+def reconstruct_original_dataclass(self) -> Any:
+    """
+    This function is dynamically mapped to FlatClass as an instance method.
+    """
+    sorted_classes = topological_sort(self.dataclass_dependencies)
+    instances = {}
+
+    for _cls in reversed(sorted_classes):
+        args = {}
+
+        for prefixed_field_name, original_field_name, field_type in self.dataclass_args[
+            _cls
+        ]:
+            if is_subclass(field_type, BasePolyConfig):
+                config_type = getattr(self, f"{original_field_name}_type")
+                # find all subclasses of field_type and check which one matches the config_type
+                config_type_matched = False
+                for subclass in get_all_subclasses(field_type):
+                    if str(subclass.get_type()) == config_type:
+                        config_type_matched = True
+                        args[original_field_name] = instances[subclass]
+                        break
+                assert (
+                    config_type_matched
+                ), f"Invalid type {config_type} for {prefixed_field_name}_type. Valid types: {[str(subclass.get_type()) for subclass in get_all_subclasses(field_type)]}"
+            elif hasattr(field_type, "__dataclass_fields__"):
+                args[original_field_name] = instances[field_type]
+            else:
+                value = getattr(self, prefixed_field_name)
+                if callable(value):
+                    # to handle default factory values
+                    value = value()
+                args[original_field_name] = value
+
+        instances[_cls] = _cls(**args)
+
+    return instances[sorted_classes[0]]
+
+
+@classmethod
+def create_from_cli_args(cls) -> Any:
+    """
+    This function is dynamically mapped to FlatClass as a class method.
+    """
+    parser = ArgumentParser(formatter_class=ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter)
+
+    for field in fields(cls):
+        nargs = None
+        action = None
+        field_type = field.type
+        help_text = cls.metadata_mapping[field.name].get("help", None)
+
+        if is_list(field.type):
+            assert is_composed_of_primitives(field.type)
+            field_type = get_args(field.type)[0]
+            if is_primitive_type(field_type):
+                nargs = "+"
+            else:
+                field_type = json.loads
+        elif is_dict(field.type):
+            assert is_composed_of_primitives(field.type)
+            field_type = json.loads
+        elif is_bool(field.type):
+            action = BooleanOptionalAction
+
+        arg_params = {
+            "action": action,
+            "help": help_text,
+        }
+        # BooleanOptionalAction supplies its own values and does not accept type
+        # on Python 3.14+. Other actions still need their type conversion.
+        if action is not BooleanOptionalAction:
+            arg_params["type"] = field_type
+
+        # handle cases with default and default factory args
+        if field.default is not MISSING:
+            value = field.default
+            if callable(value):
+                value = value()
+            arg_params["default"] = value
+        elif field.default_factory is not MISSING:
+            arg_params["default"] = field.default_factory()
+        else:
+            arg_params["required"] = True
+
+        if nargs:
+            arg_params["nargs"] = nargs
+        parser.add_argument(f"--{field.name}", **arg_params)
+
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    return cls(**vars(args))
+
+
+def create_flat_dataclass(input_dataclass: Any) -> Any:
+    """
+    Creates a new FlatClass type by recursively flattening the input dataclass.
+    This allows for easy parsing of command line arguments along with storing/loading the configuration to/from a file.
+    """
+    meta_fields_with_defaults = []
+    meta_fields_without_defaults = []
+    processed_classes = set()
+    dataclass_args = defaultdict(list)
+    dataclass_dependencies = defaultdict(set)
+    metadata_mapping = {}
+
+    def process_dataclass(_input_dataclass, prefix=""):
+        if _input_dataclass in processed_classes:
+            return
+
+        processed_classes.add(_input_dataclass)
+
+        for field in fields(_input_dataclass):
+            prefixed_name = f"{prefix}{field.name}"
+
+            if is_optional(field.type):
+                field_type = get_inner_type(field.type)
+            else:
+                field_type = field.type
+
+            # # if field is a BasePolyConfig, add a type argument and process it as a dataclass
+            if is_subclass(field_type, BasePolyConfig):
+                dataclass_args[_input_dataclass].append(
+                    (field.name, field.name, field_type)
+                )
+
+                type_field_name = f"{field.name}_type"
+                default_value = str(field.default_factory().get_type())
+                meta_fields_with_defaults.append(
+                    (type_field_name, type(default_value), default_value)
+                )
+                metadata_mapping[type_field_name] = field.metadata
+
+                assert hasattr(field_type, "__dataclass_fields__")
+                for subclass in get_all_subclasses(field_type):
+                    dataclass_dependencies[_input_dataclass].add(subclass)
+                    process_dataclass(subclass, f"{to_snake_case(subclass.__name__)}_")
+                continue
+
+            # if field is a dataclass, recursively process it
+            if hasattr(field_type, "__dataclass_fields__"):
+                dataclass_dependencies[_input_dataclass].add(field_type)
+                dataclass_args[_input_dataclass].append(
+                    (field.name, field.name, field_type)
+                )
+                process_dataclass(field_type, f"{to_snake_case(field_type.__name__)}_")
+                continue
+
+            field_default = field.default if field.default is not MISSING else MISSING
+            field_default_factory = (
+                field.default_factory
+                if field.default_factory is not MISSING
+                else MISSING
+            )
+
+            if field_default is not MISSING:
+                meta_fields_with_defaults.append(
+                    (prefixed_name, field_type, field_default)
+                )
+            elif field_default_factory is not MISSING:
+                meta_fields_with_defaults.append(
+                    (prefixed_name, field_type, field_default_factory)
+                )
+            else:
+                meta_fields_without_defaults.append((prefixed_name, field_type))
+
+            dataclass_args[_input_dataclass].append(
+                (prefixed_name, field.name, field_type)
+            )
+            metadata_mapping[prefixed_name] = field.metadata
+
+    process_dataclass(input_dataclass)
+
+    meta_fields = meta_fields_without_defaults + meta_fields_with_defaults
+    FlatClass = make_dataclass("FlatClass", meta_fields)
+
+    # Metadata fields
+    FlatClass.dataclass_args = dataclass_args
+    FlatClass.dataclass_dependencies = dataclass_dependencies
+    FlatClass.metadata_mapping = metadata_mapping

+from dataclasses import fields, is_dataclass
+from typing import Union, get_args, get_origin
+
+primitive_types = {int, str, float, bool, type(None)}
+
+
+def get_all_subclasses(cls):
+    subclasses = cls.__subclasses__()
+    return subclasses + [g for s in subclasses for g in get_all_subclasses(s)]
+
+
+def is_primitive_type(field_type: type) -> bool:
+    # Check if the type is a primitive type
+    return field_type in primitive_types
+
+
+def is_generic_composed_of_primitives(field_type: type) -> bool:
+    origin = get_origin(field_type)
+    if origin in {list, dict, tuple, Union}:
+        # Check all arguments of the generic type
+        args = get_args(field_type)
+        return all(is_composed_of_primitives(arg) for arg in args)
+    return False
+
+
+def is_composed_of_primitives(field_type: type) -> bool:
+    # Check if the type is a primitive type
+    if is_primitive_type(field_type):
+        return True
+
+    # Check if the type is a generic type composed of primitives
+    if is_generic_composed_of_primitives(field_type):
+        return True
+
+    return False
+
+
+def to_snake_case(name: str) -> str:
+    return "".join(["_" + i.lower() if i.isupper() else i for i in name]).lstrip("_")
+
+
+def is_optional(field_type: type) -> bool:
+    return get_origin(field_type) is Union and type(None) in get_args(field_type)
+
+
+def is_list(field_type: type) -> bool:
+    # Check if the field type is a List
+    return get_origin(field_type) is list
+
+
+def is_dict(field_type: type) -> bool:
+    # Check if the field type is a Dict
+    return get_origin(field_type) is dict
+
+
+def is_bool(field_type: type) -> bool:
+    return field_type is bool
+
+
+def get_inner_type(field_type: type) -> type:
+    return next(t for t in get_args(field_type) if t is not type(None))
+
+
+def is_subclass(cls, parent: type) -> bool:
+    return hasattr(cls, "__bases__") and parent in cls.__bases__
+
+
+def dataclass_to_dict(obj):
+    if isinstance(obj, list):
+        return [dataclass_to_dict(item) for item in obj]
+    elif is_dataclass(obj):
+        data = {}
+        for field in fields(obj):
+            value = getattr(obj, field.name)
+            data[field.name] = dataclass_to_dict(value)
+        # Include members created in __post_init__
+        for key, value in obj.__dict__.items():
+            if key not in data:
+                data[key] = dataclass_to_dict(value)
+        # Include the name of the class
+        if hasattr(obj, "get_type") and callable(getattr(obj, "get_type")):
+            data["name"] = str(obj.get_type())
+        elif hasattr(obj, "get_name") and callable(getattr(obj, "get_name")):
+            data["name"] = obj.get_name()
+        return data
+    else:
+        return obj

+from vidur.config_optimizer.analyzer.bottleneck_cases import *
+
+
+class BottleneckAnalyzer:
+    """
+    Why I can't get more capacity out of my replica?
+    C1. Violates TFFT SLO
+        C1.1 Limited by  max batch size - Batch size saturated - mean memory usage is low.
+        C1.2 Limited by memory availability - Memory usage is high, batch size is lower than limit.
+        C1.3 Limited by prefill throughput - None of the above applies (NEED BETTER STRAT).
+            C1.3.1 Low efficiency due to pipeline bubbles - high idle time and pipeline parallelism.
+            X C1.3.2 Low efficiency due to network latency - high TP comm time.
+            X C1.3.3 Low efficiency due to chunking overhead - lower prefill MFU and small chunk size.
+            X C1.3.4 Slow prefill due to low parallelism - high prefill MFU and low TP degree.
+    C2. Violates TBT SLO
+        C2.1 High latency model execution - P25/P50 TBT is high.
+            C2.1.1 Stalls due to pipeline bubbles - high idle time and pipeline parallelism.
+            X C2.1.2 High latency due to network latency - lower MFU and high TP degree.
+            X C2.1.4 Slow prefill due to low parallelism - high MFU and low TP degree.
+            X C2.1.3 High latency due to chunking overhead - high chunk size.
+        C2.2 High tail latency - lower percentiles are okay but tail latency is violated.
+            C2.2.1 High tail latency due to scheduling problems - non-sarathi scheduler.
+            C2.2.2 High tail latency due to large chunk size - sarathi scheduler and high chunk size.
+
+    Classes marked with X are not implemented yet, and require more metrics to be implemented.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, ttft_slo_percentile, ttft_slo_value, tbt_slo_percentile, tbt_slo_value
+    ):
+        self.ttft_slo_percentile = ttft_slo_percentile
+        self.ttft_slo_value = ttft_slo_value
+        self.tbt_slo_percentile = tbt_slo_percentile
+        self.tbt_slo_value = tbt_slo_value
+
+    def analyze(self, config_row):
+        """
+        Analyze the config row and return the bottleneck.
+        """
+        params = (
+            config_row,
+            self.ttft_slo_percentile,
+            self.ttft_slo_value,
+            self.tbt_slo_percentile,
+            self.tbt_slo_value,
+        )
+
+        # put child classes before parent classes
+        match_seq = [
+            TFFTViolationLowMaxBatchSizeCase,
+            TFFTViolationLowMemoryCase,
+            TFFTViolationLowPrefillThroughputPipelineBubblesCase,
+            TFFTViolationLowPrefillThroughputCase,
+            TBTViolationHighModelExecutionLatencyPipelineBubblesCase,
+            TBTViolationHighModelExecutionLatencyCase,
+            TBTViolationHighTailLatencySchedulerCase,
+            TBTViolationHighTailLatencySarathiChunkSizeCase,
+        ]
+
+        # find and return the first match
+        for case in match_seq:
+            case_inst = case(*params)
+            if case_inst.is_match():
+                return case_inst.get_message()
+
+        return "Could not interpret the bottleneck."
